LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT JOESIAH BELL'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT. THE DEMURRER FOR MISJOINDER IS OVERRULED BASED ON THE RECORD BEFORE THE COURT. PLAINTIFF HAS ALLEGED CLAIMS AGAINST DEFENDANT PERSONALLY AND AGAINST DEFENDANTS DBA AND THE COURT CANNOT CONCLUDE THAT THE CHURCH AS A SEPARATE ENTITY IS A NECESSARY LET ALONE INDISPENSABLE PARTY. PLAINTIFF MAY AMEND TO ADD THE CHURCH AS AN INDEPENDENT PARTY, BUT IF PLAINTIFF CHOOSES NOT TO, IT MAY PROCEED AGAINST DEFENDANT WITH THE RISK THAT IF PLAINTIFF'S DBA VIOLATIONS ARE NOT PROVED SOME OF ITS CLAIMS MAY FAIL. THE DEMURRER IS SUSTAINED WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 5 TO PLEAD THE NECESSARY ELEMENTS OF AN ACTIONABLE CONSPIRACY WITH APPROPRIATE CLARITY AND IS SUSTAINED WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND AS TO CAUSES OF ACTION 7 AND 8 TO PLEAD INTERFERENCE WITH SOME THIRD PARTY RELATIONSHIP. THE DEMURRER IS OTHERWISE OVERRULED. PREVAILING PARTY TO PREPARE ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR 8189
